summary: Made the durable record match what is now measured, without adding new inference. The core gap's Knowledge entry is updated (it had been narrowed to two nodes): its conditions now read two or three nodes with quorum-critical losses — one dropped Accepted receipt at two nodes, two at three — and it cites both receipts by their decisive indices (three-node event 3 and two-node event 1), stating the measured consequence (entry undecided for 100 configured resend periods, only heartbeats on the wire after the drop, and the later proposal as the only repair in the window) together with the unchanged mechanism statement, with the earlier revision and its two-node receipt preserved and no affected uses recorded. The compaction/attribution finding is promoted as a second Knowledge entry: the actor owns the instance and exposes no compaction path, and on the failure side a storage write error is fatal in the core (expect(WRITE_ERROR_MSG)), that panic happens inside the task spawn_actor launched with no join handle kept, and the layer's only value for an absent actor is Shutdown — so the death reaches callers as an orderly shutdown with the core's message lost; it is marked source-settled and carries its nine sources. Incomplete work, stated rather than implied: the write-refusal premise of that failure side has still not been exercised (a Storage implementation that fails a write, with the actor's death and the caller-visible Shutdown observed) — that is the natural next probe if the run continues. The four findings otherwise stand as recorded: the event-backpressure park and cluster stall (capacities 8/64/1024, corrected transport, 21.69s bound), the core's missing accept-phase repair (measured at two and three nodes), and append_notify's false Ok for an unadopted index with the adopted-vs-unadopted boundary measured.
